en.title: Soy-Marinated Chicken Breasts
en.intro: This is a traditional Egyptian dish prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices.

steps.n1: Cut the chicken into thin slices and marinate with onion, salt, pepper and mixed spice, then add soy sauce in proportion to the chicken, along with lemon juice or vinegar.
steps.n3: Coat the marinated chicken in flour or cornstarch, then fry it in oil.
